description: Accept the vendor's offer and lock in the deal. Consequential: only call after the buyer has approved this exact offer, every time. Provide the offer version the buyer reviewed and approved; a changed offer needs a new approval. Read state.acceptance_effects and state.commits_purchase first: merchant handoff effects may be unknown. Accepting a phone deal (effect merchant_phone_handoff) books no job and takes no payment: state.acceptance_summary says what it does. haggl.ai never takes payment: any payment happens at the merchant's checkout, under the merchant's terms and refund policy. A returned checkout link alone does not establish payment or enrollment completion. Accepting the same offer version again returns the same result.

expected_offer_version.description: state.offer_version from the quote reviewed and approved by the buyer.

round.description: Legacy offer round. If supplied it must match the current or already reserved offer.

session_id.description: Session id of the negotiation to accept.
